subject: Post-call: FinLytics security discovery, evidence requests & next steps
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Amit Rao <amit@finlytics.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: FinLytics security discovery, evidence requests & next steps

Hi Amit —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we have alignment on what evidence and decisions your team needs to qualify Redwood for production: 

Primary pain points you shared
- Audit log retention and export: must retain event-level logs for 7 years and be able to export in CSV/NDJSON for auditors.
- DPA and contractual wording for data residency + subprocessor list.
- Pen test evidence / scope and whether Redwood can share recent remediation notes.
- SOC 2 Type II: need confirmation of scope and ability to share a redacted report/attestation.

Goals you outlined
- Get a concise evidence pack for procurement by 10/20 to pass to legal & infosec.
- Confirm default retention behavior and steps to enable long-term retention for a specific bucket of audit events.
- Lock on DPA terms or agree to a DocuSign path for execution.

What we will provide (attachments linked below)
1) SOC2_TypeII_Coverletter.pdf — high-level attestation summary and contact for the audit firm (attached).
2) audit-logs-sample.csv.gz — sanitized sample extract showing fields & timestamps.
3) dpa-draft-redlines.docx — draft DPA with our suggested redlines for your legal review.

Proposed next steps (owners & ETA)
- Redwood (Neha): Deliver full evidence pack (SOC2 cover letter + logs sample + SSO/KMS note) by 2026-10-14.
- Redwood (Vivek): Provide answers on pen-test scope + remediation summary by 2026-10-15.
- FinLytics (Amit / security@finlytics.com): Confirm if exported sample schema is sufficient by 2026-10-16 and supply any additional evidence requests.
- Schedule 30-min follow-up (technical) the week of 10/19 if needed.

If anything above is misremembered or you want a different timeline, please let me know. Otherwise we’ll proceed with the attachments and timeline.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_Coverletter.pdf; audit-logs-sample.csv.gz; dpa-draft-redlines.docx

From: Amit Rao <amit@finlytics.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finlytics.com
Date: 2026-10-12T16:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: FinLytics security discovery, evidence requests & next steps

Neha —

Thanks for the clear recap. Couple of quick clarifications so we can triage internally: 

1) Retention: when you say "configurable retention for an event bucket," is that a per-tenant setting today or does it require a support ticket/engineering change? We need it to be self-service or on a clearly documented process.

2) Audit log schema: the sample looks promising — can you confirm the list of fields (user_id, request_id, resource_path, action, timestamp, ip, region) will always be present? Also, can we get a short data dictionary for each field?

3) Pen test: what year is the most recent external pen test and does the remediation summary include CVE references we can cross-check? Our security team prefers triage based on CVE ids if possible.

We’ll review the attachments and get back by end of day 10/14. If possible, can you also provide a DocuSign-enabled DPA link so our legal can track the workflow?

—Amit
Amit Rao
Head of IT & Security, FinLytics
amit@finlytics.com | +1 (212) 555-0107

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Amit Rao <amit@finlytics.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: FinLytics security discovery, evidence requests & next steps

Amit —

Thanks for the questions. Short answers below and attached artifacts that should help your security team triage immediately: 

1) Retention model
- Retention is tenant-configurable via the Redwood Console for audit logs. Default retention is 90 days; we support custom retention policies (7 years is supported) that can be applied to named audit streams. Enabling 7-year retention is self-service for accounts on Dedicated or Private; for Hosted accounts we can enable via an admin console toggle (we will document the steps for your ops team).

2) Audit log schema
- The sample attached (audit-logs-sample.csv.gz) contains the full field set. Canonical fields: timestamp, tenant_id, user_id, request_id, service, resource_path, action, status_code, ip_address, user_agent, region, request_payload_hash. I will follow up with a one-page data dictionary.

3) Pen test & SOC2
- Most recent external penetration test: 2026-06 by RedCliff Security (summary attached). We can provide a remediation summary that maps findings to CVE ids where applicable — some items are configuration items or internal mitigations that do not have a CVE, and we’ll note those.
- SOC 2 Type II: attached is SOC2_TypeII_Coverletter.pdf. We can share a redacted report under an NDA if FinLytics prefers that.

Attachments included in this reply: SOC2_TypeII_Coverletter.pdf (cover letter), audit-logs-sample.csv.gz (sanitized sample), pen-test-summary-202606.pdf (summary & remediation notes), dpa-draft-redlines.docx (DPA draft).

Next steps I propose
- Redwood to provide the one-page data dictionary by 2026-10-14 (owner: Marcus Lin).
- If FinLytics wants a redacted SOC2 report, sign the mutual NDA and we’ll deliver within 72 hours of receiving the signed NDA.
- For DPA redlines, we can put the DocuSign envelope together once we have your legal contact; Neha, can you confirm the primary legal contact?

Happy to hop on a short call if you want to walk through the attachments — I’m available 10/14 afternoon.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Security Lead | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0123

--
Forwarded attachments (stubs): SOC2_TypeII_Coverletter.pdf; audit-logs-sample.csv.gz; pen-test-summary-202606.pdf; dpa-draft-redlines.docx

From: Amit Rao <amit@finlytics.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finlytics.com
Date: 2026-10-13T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: FinLytics security discovery, evidence requests & next steps

Vivek / Neha —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few items from our side: 
- The sample schema looks good; we’ll confirm with our auditors if any additional fields are required but this covers the majority.
- We will share our legal contact (legal.ops@finlytics.com) for the DPA and sign the mutual NDA to get the redacted SOC2 report.
- For retention enablement: we are on Hosted today — please include the enablement steps and any expected billing delta for moving a bucket to 7-year retention.

Proposing a 30-min sync on Thursday 2026-10-15 at 10:00am PT to walk through the audit log sample and DPA questions. Can you confirm?

Thanks,
Amit
